name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: SEO & Content Strategy | Technical SEO, AI Search, B2B
summary: SEO and content strategist with 4 years of hands-on SEO inside a 15+ year career across agency, MarTech, and B2B SaaS. Runs technical SEO audits in Screaming Frog, implements schema and structured data, and directs content against keyword gaps and buyer pain points for a multi-client book at Solenzo. Builds LLM-based workflows daily with Claude Code, Claude, and ChatGPT, and built rubric-based grading criteria to evaluate AI-assisted audit output, which is the practical foundation for AI-search visibility work. Led a team of up to 20 at Wix, including hiring and training.

experience.title: SEO & Content Strategy (Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead)
bullets: Own SEO strategy across a portfolio of client accounts, running technical audits, keyword gap analyses, and competitor research with Screaming Frog, Ahrefs, and Semrush.
Identify and implement schema and structured data in every technical audit, and fix crawlability and on-page issues directly in client CMS platforms.
Direct content strategy from client discovery: translate business goals and buyer pain points into prioritized topics, landing pages, and educational guides.
Track organic performance and conversion in GA4, Google Search Console, and Google Tag Manager, and report results with next-step recommendations.
Use Claude Code, Claude, and ChatGPT daily to build LLM workflows, and built rubric-based grading criteria to score AI-assisted SEO audit output against defined standards.
Write and publish thought leadership, newsletters, and guides for B2B audiences on systems, CRM, and growth operations.

Ran Google keyword research and search-term analysis to shape targeting and content direction.
Built reporting frameworks tracking ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion, delivering QBRs and recommendations.

Managed 15-20 reseller partners, retaining all but one (~94% retention).
